title: Transformer 拒绝机制中的组件与维度稀疏性
summary: 研究将拒绝引导分解为四个开源权重模型的组件级干预，发现拒绝方向集中在28-48%的上游组件中，保留88-101%的引导效果；在这些机制内，有效引导进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留85-98%的效果。表明拒绝行为由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成，而非弥散编码。
summary_en: This work decomposes refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, finding that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28-48% of upstream components while retaining 88-101% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in ~50% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85-98% of the baseline, showing refusal is assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism rather than diffusely encoded.
